feed.title: Kroger shoppers are losing money as shocking study reveals hundreds of pricing errors
feed.summary: A new study by the Center for Responsible Food Business (CRFB) reveals that Kroger stores in Ohio have been overcharging customers due to widespread pricing errors. Government inspections found 644 incorrect prices across 389 inspections from 2022 to mid-2026, with overcharges occurring about three times more often than undercharges. Customers were often charged significantly more than the advertised shelf price, with one instance showing a 55% overcharge on eggs due to digital coupon failures.
